report.success_criterion: On the buggy commit, after adding only the PR's two test functions (no source fix), pytest exits non-zero with both test_probit_loglikeobs_extreme_linpred and test_probit_extreme_observation_fit failing on the finiteness/rtol assertions; the same tests pass once the discrete_model.py log-space fix is applied.

examples.input: test_probit_loglikeobs_extreme_linpred: sm.Probit(y, X) with n=50, z=np.linspace(-1e4, 1e4), X=np.column_stack([np.ones(n), z]), y=np.ones(n, dtype=int), params=np.array([0.0, 1.0]); then model.loglikeobs/loglike/score_obs/hessian(params)
examples.expected_output: all finite: loglikeobs == stats.norm.logcdf(z) (rtol=1e-14); loglike == loglikeobs.sum() (rtol=1e-14); score_obs == mills[:, None] * X with mills = exp(stats.norm.logpdf(z) - stats.norm.logcdf(z)) (rtol=1e-12); hessian finite
examples.buggy_output_reported: loglikeobs flat at log(FLOAT_EPS) = -36.04 for z below about -8 and -inf below about -38; score ~0 (pdf underflows) where the true value grows like |z|; hessian nan via 0/0 = pdf/cdf below about z = -38

examples.input: test_probit_extreme_observation_fit: n=300, rng=np.random.default_rng(1), x=rng.standard_normal(n), y=(1.5*x+rng.standard_normal(n)>0).astype(int), x=append(x,40.0), y=append(y,0), X=[ones,x], q=2*y-1, params=[0.0,1.5]; assert z.min() < -50
examples.expected_output: model.loglike(params)==stats.norm.logcdf(z).sum() (rtol=1e-12); model.score(params)==X.T @ (q*mills) (rtol=1e-12) and matches approx_fprime_cs (rtol=1e-8); hessian matches approx_hess (rtol=1e-4); newton and bfgs converge with res.params ~ ref.x (rtol=1e-4), res.llf == -ref.fun (rtol=1e-8), finite bse
examples.buggy_output_reported: clipped loglike and score far from the exact values; unclipped hessian nan; bfgs stopped at a spurious optimum with nan standard errors; newton/bfgs do not match the exact-loglikelihood optimum
